methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible, accessed 2026-06-14; adversarially re-verified 2026-06-15. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month (monthly-billing) rate; annual-billing monthly rates are noted in plan notes. annualDiscountPct is set when both monthly and annual rates are explicitly published, otherwise null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). monthlyUsd = null for quote-only / contact-sales tiers. VERIFICATION CORRECTIONS (2026-06-15): Typeform Basic/Plus/Business/Growth Flow monthlyUsd were stale 2023-era prices ($29/$59/$99/$349) and were corrected to current official month-to-month rates ($39/$79/$129/$379, annual $28/$56/$91/$266) from typeform.com/pricing. Tally Business was recorded null but a confirmable USD self-serve price of $89/mo exists (joinsecret.com + multiple listings; €65/mo on official EUR-only page) and was added. Tally Pro $29/mo, Jotform ($39/$49/$129), Formstack ($99/$299), Fillout ($15/$40/$75), Wufoo annual rates, Cognito Forms ($19/$39/$129), and Google Workspace ($7/$14/$22/user monthly billing) were independently confirmed and left unchanged. Google Workspace USD rates obtained from workspace.google.com with hl=en_US&region=US query params. Wufoo official page advertises annual-billing monthly rates directly (25% annual discount).

vendors.name: Typeform
vendors.provenance: https://www.typeform.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; re-verified 2026-06-15 — initial capture used stale 2023-era prices, corrected to current month-to-month and annual rates from the live page)

plans.name: Basic

plans.name: Plus

plans.name: Business

plans.name: Growth Flow
plans.notes: 5 seats, 10,000 responses/month, video questions (50,000 views/mo). Month-to-month: $379/mo. Annual billing rate: $266/mo ($3,192/yr). Prior recorded $349/$291 values were stale; corrected against official typeform.com/pricing 2026-06-15.

plans.name: Talent

plans.name: Enterprise

plans.name: Workspace Standard

plans.name: Workspace Plus
plans.notes: Per user/month (monthly billing: $22/user/mo). 5 TB storage/user, eDiscovery, attendance tracking, meetings up to 500 participants. Annual billing saves ~16% (approx $18.48/user/mo).

plans.name: Workspace Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Unlimited storage, enhanced security and compliance, advanced eDiscovery, HIPAA BAA available.

USD pricing obtained from third-party listings: slashdot.org and alternativeto.net both cite $29/mo for Pro. Business USD price could not be verified from any accessible USD-denominated source and is recorded as null.

plans.notes: USD price $29/mo per slashdot.org and alternativeto.net listings; official page shows EUR €20/mo only. Removes Tally branding, custom domain, unlimited team members, unlimited file uploads, extended analytics, 30-day version history. Annual billing available (2 months free).

plans.name: Business

Includes all Pro features plus data retention controls, email verification, 90-day version history. Prior null was over-conservative — confirmable USD self-serve price exists; corrected 2026-06-15.
